metadata.description: Azure region for tenant-specific Azure resources (must match the shared resources in this RG).
Tag map applied to every tenant-scoped resource. Includes a `tenant` tag for billing/inventory queries.

Existing Cosmos DB account that will host the per-tenant SQL database.

Existing Log Analytics workspace name (the per-tenant Application Insights resource links to this workspace).

eval-service container image tag.
storage-proxy container image tag.

Azure region.
Container App name (e.g. ca-eval-svc-zava).
Resource ID of an existing Container Apps managed environment with VNet injection.
